observations: Photo 0: A disassembled metal transmission/gearbox housing section sitting on a dirty concrete/stone surface, with three long threaded guide rods/bolts inserted through it. Visible gear teeth, bearings, and small bolts. Another gearbox casing part visible in the background top of frame. Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI UCHENNA'.

Photo 1: A hand holding up a separate metal housing piece (possibly a bearing carrier or shift fork housing) with two round bearing/bushing openings, resting among the same long threaded rods seen in photo 0. Same watermark present.

Photo 2: Close-up of a cast metal gearbox casing with multiple bolts, dowels, and an embossed marking reading '5-B' on the casing. Surface is machined aluminum-alloy colored metal, sitting on a concrete floor. Same watermark present.
